body.en: EP tracks useful participation: reactions, events, content, help, and consistency. It is a signal for SEED readiness, not a replacement for judgment.
body.pt-BR: EP mede participacao util: reacoes, eventos, conteudo, ajuda e consistencia. E um sinal para SEED, nao substitui avaliacao humana.

body.en: Weekly Active adds +100 EP when you maintain useful weekly presence.
body.pt-BR: Weekly Active adiciona +100 EP quando voce mantem presenca semanal util.

body.en: Reacting to official announcements is a small habit with compounding value.
body.pt-BR: Reagir a anuncios oficiais e um pequeno habito com valor acumulado.

body.en: Events reward presence, contribution, and helping newcomers in real time.
body.pt-BR: Eventos recompensam presenca, contribuicao e ajuda a newcomers em tempo real.

body.en: A setup needs context: tested support, funding, volume, and confirmation. FOMO is not analysis.
body.pt-BR: Um setup precisa de contexto: suporte testado, funding, volume e confirmacao. FOMO nao e analise.

body.en: DUSD content should explain structure honestly: delta-neutral design reduces directional exposure; it is not magic yield.
body.pt-BR: Conteudo sobre DUSD deve explicar a estrutura honestamente: delta-neutral reduz exposicao direcional; nao e yield magico.

body.en: Strong content teaches, analyzes, and gives context in a human voice.
body.pt-BR: Conteudo forte ensina, analisa e da contexto com voz humana.

body.en: SEED review weighs EP, quality, attitude, and genuine contribution.
body.pt-BR: A revisao de SEED considera EP, qualidade, atitude e contribuicao genuina.

body.en: SEED is the first recognized role in the Growth Path and the entry point to squad responsibility.
body.pt-BR: SEED e o primeiro cargo reconhecido no Growth Path e a entrada para responsabilidades de squad.

body.en: Squads focus your contribution: Content/Research, Creative, Tech Support, Outreach, and Offline.
body.pt-BR: Squads direcionam sua contribuicao: Content/Research, Creative, Tech Support, Outreach e Offline.
